records.title: PouchDB 9.0.0 release
records.version_or_commit: PouchDB 9.0.0; release tag; GitHub shows short commit b2882c1
records.locator: Release title, version, commit, IndexedDB adapter stability and find() default limit
records.observed_operation: Viewed the current release metadata; no package was installed.
records.conditions_defaults_exceptions: The release records the browser IndexedDB adapter and a default .find limit of 25; it does not establish a product-specific sync policy.
records.applicability: Pins the considered PouchDB version and signals that search pagination defaults must be explicit.

records.title: About PouchDB
records.version_or_commit: Live unversioned docs; no release/commit binding shown
records.locator: Sections About PouchDB and Browser Support
records.observed_operation: Read documentation describing local browser storage and client synchronization.
records.conditions_defaults_exceptions: PouchDB stores local data in IndexedDB in modern browsers and syncs to compatible servers; browser support/version statements are from live documentation.
records.applicability: Supports PouchDB as an offline-first option; actual phone/browser matrix remains to validate.

records.title: PouchDB conflicts guide
records.version_or_commit: Live unversioned docs; no release/commit binding shown
records.locator: Immediate conflicts and Eventual conflicts sections
records.observed_operation: Read the documented conflict paths and application responsibility.
records.conditions_defaults_exceptions: Revision-bound writes can return 409; disconnected peers can converge with multiple revisions and deterministic winners; application must handle conflicts.
records.applicability: Supports the need for a domain-level reconciliation UI.

records.title: PouchDB API reference
records.version_or_commit: Live unversioned docs; no release/commit binding shown
records.locator: Constructor options revs_limit; remove/purge and attachment sections; local database options
records.observed_operation: Read API reference for revision retention, deletion and attachments.
records.conditions_defaults_exceptions: Documented default revs_limit is 1000; low settings can prevent revision-relation detection; purge differs from normal replicated deletion; binary attachments are supported.
records.applicability: Informs long-offline deletion tests, image handling and deletion semantics; does not establish data erasure from backups.

records.title: CouchDB replication introduction
records.version_or_commit: Current stable documentation for CouchDB 3.5; release notes identify 3.5.3
records.locator: Transient/persistent replication; procedure; master-master; migrating data to clients
records.observed_operation: Read replication directions, checkpoints and filter conditions.
records.conditions_defaults_exceptions: Each replication is directional; bidirectional sync needs two replications; deletes replicate as new revisions; content-based filters see deleted docs without their original body; a workaround retaining all data is noted.
records.applicability: Supports comparison with application-server queues and identifies deletion/filter safety limits.

records.title: CouchDB conflict model
records.version_or_commit: Current stable documentation for CouchDB 3.5; release notes identify 3.5.3
records.locator: Sections conflict avoidance, revision trees, working with conflicting documents and views
records.observed_operation: Read normal write rejection, winner visibility, conflict retrieval and app-specific merge behavior.
records.conditions_defaults_exceptions: Same-node stale revision can return 409; replicas may retain branches; ordinary GET/view expose the deterministic winner; application must inspect and resolve branches; compaction drops non-leaf bodies.
records.applicability: Supports caution that replication and deterministic winner selection are not a domain resolution.

records.title: CouchDB changes-feed API
records.version_or_commit: Current stable documentation for CouchDB 3.5; release notes identify 3.5.3
records.locator: Query parameters include_docs, attachments, style; _changes defaults
records.observed_operation: Read feed modes and defaults affecting sync, conflict visibility and attachments.
records.conditions_defaults_exceptions: include_docs=false and attachments=false by default; include_docs with conflicts still returns only the winner; main_only is the default style; base64 inline attachments have overhead and only recent changes per doc are guaranteed.
records.applicability: Supports summary/sync design and the recommendation not to inline large photo bytes in the change feed.

records.title: CouchDB database security API
records.version_or_commit: Current stable documentation for CouchDB 3.5; release notes identify 3.5.3
records.locator: GET/PUT database security object; members and admins
records.observed_operation: Read database member/admin permissions and default behavior.
records.conditions_defaults_exceptions: Members read all document types in the database and write ordinary documents; an empty member/role set can leave ordinary docs readable/writable; new CouchDB 3.x databases default admin-only.
records.applicability: Shows database membership is not record-level privacy; keep contact data out of shared records or mediate by narrower API.

records.title: CouchDB authentication API
records.version_or_commit: Current stable documentation for CouchDB 3.5; release notes identify 3.5.3
records.locator: Proxy Authentication and JWT Authentication sections
records.observed_operation: Read external identity integration options and required configuration.
records.conditions_defaults_exceptions: Proxy auth must be enabled in the active handler list and strongly recommends a shared secret; JWT auth requires trusted signing keys and required claims. Neither identifies the center's current identity provider.
records.applicability: Supports possible integration with an existing organizational IdP while keeping identity choice unresolved.

records.title: CouchDB attachment API
records.version_or_commit: Current stable documentation for CouchDB 3.5; release notes identify 3.5.3
records.locator: PUT and DELETE attachment endpoints; revision conditions; range requests
records.observed_operation: Read attachment upload/download/delete requirements and response conditions.
records.conditions_defaults_exceptions: Updating/deleting an attachment updates the parent revision; an existing document requires current revision information; deletion requires rev or If-Match; Range requests are documented for reads.
records.applicability: Supports conflict-aware, optional attachment workflow; does not prove resumable upload semantics.

records.title: CouchDB performance and deleted documents
records.version_or_commit: Current stable documentation for CouchDB 3.5; release notes identify 3.5.3
records.locator: Deleted documents section
records.observed_operation: Read tombstone persistence and storage effects.
records.conditions_defaults_exceptions: Normal deletion creates a new _deleted revision that remains after compaction to allow replication; tombstones consume storage and affect operations.
records.applicability: Supports separate user-visible deletion from retention/physical-erasure policy.

records.title: CouchDB 3.5 release notes
records.version_or_commit: 3.5.x branch; current release notes include 3.5.3
records.locator: Version 3.5.3 bugfixes, entry for PR 6129
records.observed_operation: Read release-note inclusion of attachment revision fix.
records.conditions_defaults_exceptions: Release notes identify PR 6129 as fixing attachment revision positions when recreating a deleted document and note same-name attachments replicate afterward.
records.applicability: Pins the reported behavior's fix to a current documented release; environment-specific regression validation remains needed.

records.title: CouchDB attachment replication bug report
records.version_or_commit: Reporter states CouchDB 3.5.2; issue opened 2026-09-23 and closed by PR 6129
records.locator: Description and reproduction steps for delete/recreate before intermediate delete replicates
records.observed_operation: Read user report and reproducer; did not run its Docker commands.
records.conditions_defaults_exceptions: A report (not a standalone specification) says changed attachment contents did not reach target when same-ID/name doc was recreated before delete replication; temporary connection failure is named.
records.applicability: Directly relevant regression scenario for optional photos; treat as reported behavior fixed by PR/release evidence, not as a reproduced result here.

records.title: CouchDB PR 6129 diff
records.source_kind: Apache CouchDB pull request and source diff
records.version_or_commit: PR commit c885b36 (short SHA); merged 2026-09-25; merge commit 83a487b754af09d271ce44a60fae6e4f4c24aa8b
records.locator: src/couch/src/couch_db_updater.erl; src/couch/src/couch_att.erl; test/eunit/couch_db_recreate_att_tests.erl
records.observed_operation: Inspected code and added EUnit cases; PR page displayed 56 checks passed.
records.conditions_defaults_exceptions: Code recalculates attachment revision positions when a document is recreated over a deleted revision; regression cases cover revpos, multiple deletes, atts_since and replication.
records.applicability: Primary code/test history; tests were read but not run in this stage.

records.title: CouchDB merged fix commit

records.locator: Commit source files and regression test module couch_db_recreate_att_tests
records.observed_operation: Recorded exact merged commit from PR page; code details cross-checked in PR diff.

records.title: PowerSync update-conflict handling
records.version_or_commit: Live current docs; page does not expose a release or commit identifier
records.locator: Handling Update Conflicts section
records.observed_operation: Read upload queue, backend conflict ownership, idempotency and baseline policy.
records.conditions_defaults_exceptions: Client operations queue in order; backend processes and applies them; simplest handling is per-field LWW; docs describe idempotent operations and a typical delete-wins rule, both customizable.
records.applicability: Supports a server-authoritative alternative; application backend remains responsible for business correctness.

records.title: PowerSync custom conflict resolution
records.version_or_commit: Live current docs; page does not expose a release or commit identifier
records.locator: Business-rule validation, change-level status, server-side conflict recording strategies
records.observed_operation: Read documented backend examples and operation flow.
records.conditions_defaults_exceptions: Examples reject invalid transitions such as updates after completion; timestamps can be clock-skewed; sequence numbers and conflict tables are alternatives; retries need operation deduplication.
records.applicability: Supports stale-write prevention and explicit conflict review as app/backend policy; examples are guidance, not tested here.

records.title: PowerSync Sync Streams overview
records.version_or_commit: Live current docs; page does not expose a release or commit identifier
records.locator: Sync Streams definition, authenticated parameters, buckets and client SQLite persistence
records.observed_operation: Read per-subscriber data projection and offline persistence behavior.
records.conditions_defaults_exceptions: Streams select rows/columns by static condition or auth/subscription/connection parameters; subscribed data is persisted locally in client SQLite.
records.applicability: Supports minimized volunteer data subsets; local copies remain an explicit device and retention concern.

records.title: PowerSync self-hosting
records.version_or_commit: Live current docs; page does not expose service version/commit
records.locator: Self-hosted Docker path and enterprise edition
records.observed_operation: Read self-hosting availability and limitations.
records.conditions_defaults_exceptions: Service can be self-hosted using Docker; PowerSync Dashboard is unavailable in self-hosted mode; Enterprise Self-Hosted has support, advanced features and custom pricing.
records.applicability: Provides a feasible hosted-by-organization option with meaningful operational and commercial tradeoffs.

records.title: PowerSync licensing and terms
records.version_or_commit: Current terms accessed 2026-10-12; no release tag
records.locator: Open Edition, Cloud, Enterprise Self-Hosted, client SDK sections
records.observed_operation: Read edition/license summary.
records.conditions_defaults_exceptions: Open Edition is free source-available under FSL; Cloud and Enterprise Self-Hosted are paid/commercial; client SDKs Apache-2.0.
records.applicability: Relevant to avoiding a per-volunteer vendor account assumption, but does not establish center budget or license suitability.

records.title: Automerge introduction
records.version_or_commit: Live docs with 2026 copyright; no release/commit binding shown
records.locator: Automatic merging and local-first overview
records.observed_operation: Read offline, peer sync and optional central server description.
records.conditions_defaults_exceptions: Library offers local-first offline edits and can also use a central server; it is a data merge layer, not the full identity/access/workflow service.
records.applicability: Supports Automerge as a component alternative for collaborative notes, with system requirements still external.

records.title: Automerge conflict semantics
records.version_or_commit: Live docs with 2026 copyright; no release/commit binding shown
records.locator: Same-property concurrent write, conflicts object, operation ordering
records.observed_operation: Read merge semantics and exposed conflicts.
records.conditions_defaults_exceptions: Independent edits/list operations merge; same-property writes retain conflict alternatives while a deterministic value is returned; ordering uses operation ID, not wall time.
records.applicability: Supports use for non-status content only unless app explicitly adjudicates domain conflicts.

records.title: PowerSync checkpoint requests article
records.version_or_commit: Article dated 2026-09-09; Checkpoint Request feature requires Service 1.24.0+ and is described as alpha
records.locator: Background, consistency gates, connection requirement and request flow
records.observed_operation: Read version gate and connected-client limitations.
records.conditions_defaults_exceptions: A request waits for relevant changes through a checkpoint; upload connector must wait for backend commit; API requires connected/connecting client and article calls the feature alpha.
records.applicability: Useful only if exact sync-confirmation behavior is selected; recheck stable feature status before depending on it.

records.title: Chrome Storage Buckets and persistence
records.version_or_commit: Chromium 122+ for Storage Buckets per page; page last updated 2022-11-04 UTC
records.locator: Storage persistence request, eviction behavior, bucket persisted and durability options
records.observed_operation: Read Chrome's storage model and persistence caveats.
records.conditions_defaults_exceptions: IndexedDB may be cleared under pressure; persist() requests persistent storage and is all-or-nothing; the cited Storage Buckets API implementation is Chromium-specific and does not prevent explicit user clearing.
records.applicability: Supports a PWA reliability warning and device/browser validation; do not generalize Chromium behavior to all phones.
